heroHeadline: Adidas Ballerina "Flamboyan" Wide Release Confirmed May 30 — Named for Puerto Rico's Flamboyán Tree; European Stadium Tour Opens Barcelona in 10 Days; "DtMF" at 58 Weeks No. 1
heroSubtitle: Tracking the rise from SoundCloud uploads in Vega Baja to 100 billion Spotify streams, a historic Super Bowl LX halftime performance, and Grammy Album of the Year. On May 12, Hypebeast published the Bad Bunny x Adidas summer 2026 drop calendar: the Ballerina "Flamboyan" (Vivid Red, named for Puerto Rico's iconic flowering tree) gets an early release at All The Right on May 15 ahead of wide release May 30 via Adidas Confirmed, alongside three new F50 Ghost Sprint World Cup colorways. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour's first-ever European stadium run opens May 22–23 at Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys in Barcelona (sold out), 10 days away, continuing through Lisbon, Madrid, and 11 countries through July 22 in Brussels. The Billboard Hot Latin Songs chart dated May 9 confirms "DtMF" at 58 consecutive weeks at No. 1 — further extending Bad Bunny's own all-time record beyond "Despacito" (56 weeks). The 30th Annual Webby Award for Best Fan Engagement, won by the "Tracking Bad Bunny" location-based campaign (DDB Latina Puerto Rico), was formally presented at Cipriani Wall Street on May 11.
footerNote: Data sourced from Rimas Entertainment, Billboard, Spotify Newsroom, RIAA, Latin Recording Academy, Recording Academy, Pollstar, Webby Awards, DDB Latina Puerto Rico, Adidas Newsroom, The Hollywood Reporter, Variety, Bloomberg, NPR, Remezcla, Deadline, Complex, Bleacher Report, Rolling Stone, Live Nation, Estadi Olímpic Barcelona, Sneaker News, Hypebeast, Sneaker Bar Detroit, and major media
